A sampled Workflow 12.0.2605.385 Designer definition version matched current_ver. A running instance used an older definition version; join instance history to workflow_code using the instance version rather than current_ver.

iname.purpose: Internal name for the Workflow definition.

dbo.workflow_category.summary: Workflow metadata records for workflow category.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow category records for read-only Workflow metadata reporting.

category_id.purpose: Category identifier for the workflow category record.

category_name.purpose: Category Name for the workflow category record.

parent_id.purpose: Parent identifier for the workflow category record.

dbo.workflow_category_link.summary: Workflow metadata records for workflow category link.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow category link records for read-only Workflow metadata reporting.

link_id.purpose: Link identifier for the workflow category link record.

category_id.purpose: Category identifier for the workflow category link record.

dbo.workflow_code.summary: Workflow definition, code, or object metadata records for workflow code payload.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow code payload records for read-only diagnostics after reviewing whether payloads contain workflow logic or runtime data.

Use workflow_id together with version to resolve a definition revision. Read-only Workflow 12.0.2605.385 checks validated sampled current versions and version-qualified object links, not serialization formats or successful execution. Prefer payload byte counts to exposing code or assemblies.

designer_code.purpose: Workflow Designer text payload associated with this definition/version (ntext). Serialization and version compatibility are undocumented; it is not a runtime execution log.

workflow_assembly.purpose: Binary image-typed workflow assembly payload associated with this definition/version. Packaging is undocumented; do not execute it or infer successful compilation or runtime state from its presence.

last_update.purpose: Timestamp when the row was last changed.

csharp_assembly.purpose: Binary image-typed payload named for a C# assembly in this workflow definition/version. Its packaging and loading rules are undocumented; do not execute it or assume it is a file path.

vb_assembly.purpose: Binary image-typed payload named for a Visual Basic assembly in this workflow definition/version. Format and loading rules are undocumented; do not execute it or assume it is a file path.

dbo.workflow_external_objects.summary: Workflow definition, code, or object metadata records for workflow external object.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow external object records for read-only diagnostics after reviewing whether payloads contain workflow logic or runtime data.

id.purpose: identifier for the workflow external object record.

object_type.purpose: Object Type value for the workflow external object record; verify mapping before public reporting when applicable.

object_xml.purpose: Serialized XML payload for the workflow external object.

object_flags.purpose: Object Flags for the workflow external object record.

dbo.workflow_history.summary: History or log records for workflow history row.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow history row records for read-only Workflow metadata reporting.

Read-only Workflow 12.0.2605.385 aggregate checks found history rows without a matching current workflow. Drive history reports from this table and LEFT JOIN current metadata; absence does not prove a deletion cause. Action meanings remain unverified.

user_id.purpose: User identifier for the workflow history row record.

action.purpose: History action code; observed values are not independently mapped to a complete action reference. Do not label an unmatched current workflow as deleted solely from this code.

workflow_name.purpose: Workflow name copied into the row for reporting or lookup.

is_template.purpose: Flag indicating template for the workflow history row record.

modification_date.purpose: Timestamp when the row was changed.

dbo.workflow_oauth_connection.summary: Repository connection or integration records for workflow OAuth connection.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow OAuth connection records for read-only diagnostics only, and avoid exposing credentials, tokens, or connection details.

id.purpose: identifier for the workflow OAuth connection record.

client_secret.purpose: OAuth client secret; do not expose or use for reporting.

state.purpose: Serialized or encoded runtime state; verify structure before reporting.

code_verifier.purpose: OAuth code verifier; do not expose or use for reporting.

access_token.purpose: OAuth access token; do not expose or use for reporting.

refresh_token.purpose: OAuth refresh token; do not expose or use for reporting.

algorithm_ver.purpose: Algorithm Ver value for the workflow OAuth connection record; verify mapping before public reporting when applicable.

error.purpose: Error for the workflow OAuth connection record.

reference_id.purpose: Reference identifier for the workflow OAuth connection record.

reference_type.purpose: Reference Type value for the workflow OAuth connection record; verify mapping before public reporting when applicable.

last_modified_time.purpose: Timestamp when the row was last changed.

certificate_id.purpose: Certificate identifier associated with the OAuth connection.

certificate_name.purpose: Certificate name associated with the OAuth connection.

dbo.workflow_object_link.summary: Workflow definition, code, or object metadata records for workflow object link.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow object link records for read-only Workflow metadata reporting.

In the reviewed Workflow 12.0.2605.385 sample, every link resolved to workflow_code using both workflow_id and workflow_version = version. Object-type meanings and polymorphic target resolution remain unverified; do not assume every object_id references workflow_external_objects.

link_id.purpose: Link identifier for the workflow object link record.

workflow_version.purpose: Definition revision associated with this object link. Resolve workflow_code using workflow_id and workflow_version = version; this composite join covered all reviewed links in Workflow 12.0.2605.385.

object_id.purpose: Object identifier for the workflow object link record.

object_type.purpose: Object Type value for the workflow object link record; verify mapping before public reporting when applicable.

object_uuid.purpose: Object Uu identifier for the workflow object link record.

option_value.purpose: Option value; review contents before reporting.

dbo.workflow_reporting_log.summary: History or log records for workflow reporting log row.
safeReportingNotes: Use workflow reporting log row records for read-only Workflow metadata reporting.

Read-only Workflow 12.0.2605.385 correlation matched a Completed instance to reporting status 1, while current search status 5 corresponded to reporting status 4. Reporting status 3 remains unknown; not a complete enum.

Reporting rows can lack matching current or historical search detail. User and rule references can be NULL. Use LEFT JOIN for optional detail and labels; missing detail does not establish a retention cause.

report_id.purpose: Report identifier for the workflow reporting log row record.

start_time.purpose: Timestamp when the row or activity started.

end_time.purpose: Timestamp when the row or activity ended.

status.purpose: Reporting-state code. Reviewed Workflow 12.0.2605.385 samples matched 1 to Completed and 4 to a Running instance whose search status was 5. Code 3 remains unknown; this is not a complete enum.

user_name_id.purpose: Optional user-label reference to index_user_name.user_name_id. NULL occurred in reviewed reporting rows; LEFT JOIN preserves unlabeled records. Not a verified LFDS identity mapping.

rule_name_id.purpose: Optional rule-label reference to index_rule_name.rule_name_id. NULL occurred in reviewed reporting rows; LEFT JOIN preserves records without a rule label.

parent_id.purpose: Parent identifier for the workflow reporting log row record.

dbo.ai_usage.summary: Workflow AI usage records keyed by workflow and instance, used for read-only AI token usage reporting.
safeReportingNotes: Use for read-only Workflow AI usage and token consumption reporting.
Join to workflow and runtime tables only after validating the target Workflow version.
warnings: Do not modify Workflow AI usage tracking records directly.
Token counts and provider values should be validated against Workflow application behavior before billing or operational reporting.

workflow_id.purpose: Workflow definition identifier associated with the AI usage event.

instance_id.purpose: Workflow instance identifier associated with the AI usage event.

service_id.purpose: Identifier for the AI service or provider used by the workflow activity.

input_token_count.purpose: Number of input tokens recorded for the AI usage event.

output_token_count.purpose: Number of output tokens recorded for the AI usage event.

timestamp.purpose: Timestamp when the AI usage event was recorded.

dbo.ai_usage_reporting_log.summary: Aggregated Workflow AI usage reporting records by workflow, instance, and service.
safeReportingNotes: Use for read-only Workflow AI usage and token consumption reporting.
Join to workflow and runtime tables only after validating the target Workflow version.
warnings: Do not modify Workflow AI usage tracking records directly.
Token counts and provider values should be validated against Workflow application behavior before billing or operational reporting.

workflow_id.purpose: Workflow definition identifier for the aggregated AI usage reporting row.

instance_id.purpose: Workflow instance identifier for the aggregated AI usage reporting row.

service_id.purpose: Identifier for the AI service or provider included in the aggregate.

total_calls.purpose: Total number of AI calls included in the aggregate.

total_input_token_count.purpose: Total input tokens accumulated for the aggregate.

total_output_token_count.purpose: Total output tokens accumulated for the aggregate.

first_time.purpose: Earliest AI usage timestamp included in the aggregate.

last_time.purpose: Latest AI usage timestamp included in the aggregate.
